title: Convergence Rates of Factorized Gradient Descent for Overparameterized Asymmetric Matrix Sensing with Balancing Regularization
summary: We study factorized gradient descent (FGD) for overparameterized asymmetric matrix sensing with the balancing regularizer $\frac18\|L^\top L-R^\top R\|_F^2$. An exact indefinite lifting of the population objective decomposes the dynamics of FGD into positive, negative, and null spectral subspaces. The first two components have linear restoring terms, whereas the null component contracts only quadratically.
